    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script src="https://flyonui.becdn.net/pro/libs/flyonui/flyonui.js"></script>
    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in header

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code in Bottom before body section ends
    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script src="https://flyonui.becdn.net/pro/libs/flyonui/flyonui.js"></script>
    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
  

</body>

    <script src="https://flyonui.becdn.net/pro/libs/flyonui/flyonui.js"></script>
    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const url = window.location.href

      // Check if the URL contains the "theme" parameter
      const themeParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme")
      const dirRTL = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("rtl")

      // If a theme parameter is present, apply it to the document
      if (themeParam) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themeParam)
      }
      if (dirRTL === "true") {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl")
      }
    })
  </script>

  <script>
    // Place the following code in the </head> tag

    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")
    const initialTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || currentTheme || "default"
    if (initialTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", initialTheme)
    }

    // Place the following code just before the closing </body> tag

    const iconSun = document.getElementById("icon-sun")
    const iconMoon = document.getElementById("icon-moon")
    const iconSystem = document.getElementById("icon-system")
    const themeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme-dropdown"]')

    // Helper: update visible icon
    function updateThemeIcon(theme) {
      iconSun.classList.add("hidden")
      iconMoon.classList.add("hidden")
      iconSystem.classList.add("hidden")

      if (theme === "light") {
        iconSun.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else if (theme === "dark") {
        iconMoon.classList.remove("hidden")
      } else {
        iconSystem.classList.remove("hidden")
      }
    }

    // Helper: detect and apply system theme
    function applySystemTheme() {
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      const systemTheme = prefersDark ? "dark" : "light"
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", systemTheme)
      localStorage.setItem("theme", "default")
      updateThemeIcon("default") // Keep showing system icon
    }

    if (initialTheme === "default") {
      applySystemTheme()
    } else {
      updateThemeIcon(initialTheme)
    }

    // Set the correct radio on page load
    themeRadios.forEach(radio => {
      if (radio.value === initialTheme) {
        radio.checked = true
      }

      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const selectedTheme = radio.value

        if (selectedTheme === "default") {
          localStorage.removeItem("theme")
          applySystemTheme() // Use system theme
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem("theme", selectedTheme)
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", selectedTheme)
          updateThemeIcon(selectedTheme)
        }
      })
    })

    // Listen to system theme changes only if theme is default
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (initialTheme === "default") {
        applySystemTheme()
      }
    })
  </script>
